entries.title: DataGrid and Card reliability fixes
entries.summary: Restored resizable DataGrid columns and aligned subtle Card hover styling with CoreAI navigation surfaces.

sections.title: Fixed
items: DataGrid resizableColumns works again because wrapper cells no longer overwrite Fluent column sizing with an undefined style prop.
Card appearance="subtle" now uses colorNeutralBackground3Hover, matching the side navigation hover weight in light mode.

entries.title: Azure link contrast
entries.summary: Corrected Azure dark-theme link colors to meet WCAG AA contrast requirements.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Azure dark-theme links moved from brand-90 to brand-100, increasing contrast from 4.36:1 to 5.8:1.
Hover moved to brand-120 and the missing selected-link override was added to the light theme.

entries.title: Agent guidance and neutral selection
entries.summary: Shipped package-level agent guidance and changed DataGrid selection to a neutral default.

sections.title: Added
items: A distributable agent/SKILL.md guide now ships with the package and is mirrored in hosted Storybook documentation.

sections.title: Changed
items: DataGrid now defaults selectionAppearance to neutral. Pass selectionAppearance="brand" to retain Fluent's default.

entries.title: Azure theme
entries.summary: Added Azure-branded light and dark themes while preserving CoreAI's neutral surfaces and typography.

sections.title: Added
items: New azureLightTheme and azureDarkTheme exports built on the Azure and Coherence brand ramp.
New azureBrandVariants export and AzureTheme type.

sections.title: Changed
items: createCoreAIDarkTheme now includes CoreAI neutral-background overrides for every custom theme built with the factory.

entries.title: DataGrid layout controls
entries.summary: Expanded DataGrid layout control and fixed consumer style priority across CoreAI component hooks.

sections.title: Added
items: DataGrid, DataGridHeaderCell, and DataGridCell wrappers with opt-in columnFlexOptions for static flexible layouts.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Consumer className styles now correctly override CoreAI customStyleHooks_unstable styles.
Resizable Table and DataGrid layouts no longer produce an extra horizontal scrollbar.

entries.title: Smaller bundles and clearer APIs
entries.summary: Reduced default bundle cost, introduced CoreAI text presets, and clarified low-level navigation APIs.

sections.title: Breaking
items: The preview MenuGrid package is now optional and must be installed and imported directly when needed.
Markdown no longer includes math rendering and KaTeX assets by default.

sections.title: Added
items: Text gained a preset prop for CoreAI heading and body combinations while preserving explicit size and weight overrides.

sections.title: Deprecated
items: Low-level Fluent Nav components moved to Complex aliases in favor of the CoreAI Nav template.
Fluent typography preset components are deprecated in favor of CoreAI Text presets.

entries.title: CoreAI component wrappers
entries.summary: Introduced the main wrapped-component layer, custom theme factories, and shared alignment utilities.

sections.title: Added
items: Text foreground and uppercase options, Avatar neutral-alt, external Link, LinkButton, InfoButton, and brand MessageBar.
Card floatingActionPosition and CoreAI default appearance behavior.
Custom light and dark theme factories for product-specific brand ramps.
Button and TabList content-alignment utilities plus new component defaults and style hooks.

sections.title: Changed
items: Dark-theme interactive states gained stronger hover and selected contrast.
DropdownButton now uses the native Fluent Button API and appearance values.

entries.title: CoreAI rename
entries.summary: Completed the public rename from the Manifold codename to CoreAI.

sections.title: Changed
items: Renamed package folders, brand text, theme keys, exports, and documentation from Manifold to CoreAI.
The published package name remained @coreai-ds/react-components.

entries.title: Azure Artifacts release
entries.summary: Established the first @coreai-ds/react-components release on the CoreAI Azure Artifacts feed.

sections.title: Added
items: CoreAIFluentProvider, light and dark themes, component defaults, style hooks, Aptos fonts, and the Fluent UI barrel export.
Automated Azure Artifacts publishing through the protected-main release flow.

entries.title: Install docs and dark Storybook
entries.summary: Improved authenticated package installation and made dark mode the default Storybook experience.

sections.title: Changed
items: Install guidance moved to GitHub CLI authentication with user-level credentials and project-level registry configuration.
Storybook now starts in dark mode and avoids a white first-paint flash.

entries.title: React 19 and automated publishing
entries.summary: Removed React 19 installation blockers and automated package publishing from version bumps on main.

sections.title: Fixed
items: React and React DOM peer ranges now support versions from 16.14 through 19.

sections.title: Changed
items: Removed unused Storybook dependencies that forced legacy React peer resolution.
Publishing now runs automatically when a new package version lands on main and creates the matching tag after success.

entries.title: GitHub Packages release
entries.summary: Published the first version of the themed Fluent UI React package.

sections.title: Added
items: Initial package publishing workflow for the CoreAI themed Fluent UI React package.
Consumer installation and release documentation for the first package distribution flow.
